product.title: Great Ocean Road Tour Reverse -Luxury 13 Small Group-Hotel PickUP

description.text: In Melbourne, this reverse-itinerary luxury bus heads for the Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge before the main crowds, then walks the rainforest at Mait's Rest. The published format is a maximum of 13 travelers on a deluxe bus rather than an early eco mini-coach or a minivan wildlife lodge stop. The format suits visitors who want earlier lookout time without a Grampians cultural-centre day. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne CBD or Southbank, and the itinerary stays on those reverse-order coastal stops that define this outing rather than a De Bortoli tasting.

highlights: Reverse itinerary to reach lookouts earlier

start.description: Hotel pickup from Melbourne CBD and Southbank is confirmed the day before the tour, or meet at 400 Flinders St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
